method.class: Evaluator-driven width-scaling study of delayed generalization (grokking): a candidate-owned small one-layer transformer (<=1e6 parameters, AdamW, full-batch, CPU) is trained on modular addition mod a prime p while the evaluator owns data, splits, hyperparameter requests, checkpoint probing, controls, reference trainer and all metrics.
method.description: Falsifiable hypothesis (tested setting only: modular addition, fixed train fraction, AdamW weight decay 1.0, full-batch updates, one-layer transformer, evaluator-supplied width list): the evaluator-measured grokking delay gap (steps between the first checkpoint with >=99% train accuracy and the first with >=99% validation accuracy, floored at one probe interval, right-censored at the step limit) decreases with model width. Prediction: the cluster-bootstrap (over seeds, 2000 resamples, fixed seed) 95% CI of the OLS slope of ln(delay gap) versus log2(width) lies entirely below zero; refuted if the CI lies at or above zero; inconclusive if it straddles zero or evidence is incomplete. Censored or failed episodes keep the predeclared worst-case delay (the step limit) and are never omitted or renormalized. The claim is cross-checked against an evaluator-owned reference trainer slope and makes no statement about other operations, primes, optimizers, depths or larger models. Candidate-reported state is untrusted; all accuracies, delays, controls and statistics are computed by the evaluator from returned predictions.

protocol.promotion_rule: Search eligibility (correct=true) requires: all 8 declared episodes complete with exactly one reset each in the declared order; every non-control episode reaches >=99% evaluator-measured train accuracy; the label-shuffled (verified non-vacuous, >=90% labels changed) and zero-step controls both have true-label validation accuracy <=0.10; reference trainer and trivial baselines complete; wall-clock and RPC budgets respected; all metrics finite. Eligible candidates are ranked by combined_score (equal weight over seeds then widths, episode score = normalized area under the validation-accuracy curve; failed episodes contribute 0 without renormalization), ties broken by lower wall time then earlier cycle; the best eligible candidate is frozen before final resources and seeds are revealed. Final correctness (22 episodes, controls, finiteness, budgets, at least one episode reaching 99% train accuracy) is separate from the final claim assessment (CI of the log-delay slope: supported / refuted / inconclusive).

search_proxies.name: reduced_prime_width_step_search_plane
search_proxies.preserves: Same candidate RPC interface, optimizer family and hyperparameters, one-layer transformer family, evaluator-owned split/probing/controls/reference trainer, matched split across widths per seed, and the validation-accuracy-curve score.
search_proxies.omits: The larger sealed final prime and train fraction, the full final width list, longer step limit and more seeds; search uses a smaller prime, 50% train fraction, three widths, a shorter step limit and two seeds.

required_evidence: Preflight serialization of the largest production request and response (load_train with 3763 rows, predict over all 9409 pairs, and a worst-case float32-logit response) measured as UTF-8 JSON bytes including base64 expansion, envelope and framing, showing each complete message strictly below 64 MiB.

Evidence that the broker-visible reset transcripts for search, final and both smoke profiles equal the declared sequences and have exactly one reset per episode, with measured RPC counts below max_candidate_rpc_calls.

Normalized content-hash, seed, row-provenance and split-manifest disjointness report between search and final planes and between train and validation within each plane, and confirmation that no final seed, split or workload constant appears in search-visible candidate artifacts.

Control results for the label-shuffled and zero-step controls, including proof that the permutation is non-vacuous, with matched inputs, budgets and call counts, and evidence that failed or missing episodes retained worst-case contributions without renormalization.

Statement that wall-clock and broker RPC limits are enforced while candidate-internal step counts are advisory, plus evaluator-owned per-episode accuracy curves, delay gaps, censoring flags, aggregation weights, and reference-trainer results with seeds, bootstrap settings and confidence intervals for the width-delay slope.

Final claim assessment (supported, refuted or inconclusive) reported separately from search eligibility and correctness, with scope limits (single prime, operation, train fraction, depth, optimizer) and honest reporting of censored, failed or uncompleted runs; reduced-size smoke is never presented as full production evidence.
